base_row.description: *SHOP SOILED* Spectrum DC24-4 Ultra-Compact Rear-Collect/Side-Discharge Ride-On Mower with Manual Drive
base_row.marketingText: Please note - this mower is sold with a few cosmetic marks, but is still sold with a full warranty. Offering one of the most compact working-widths of any ride-on - 61cm is just 7cm wider than the biggest walk-behind - the Spectrum DC24-4 comes highly recommended for seeking an effortless way to manage a less substantial lawn, but one that's a tad too big to cover efficiently with a conventional mower. Not just one of the smallest lawn riders in production, the three-in-one Spectrum DC24-4 Ultra-Compact Ride-On Mower is also one of the most versatile, with its collection, mulching and side-discharge options providing the flexibility needed to tackle areas of differing grass types. Its wide turf wheels and lightweight built (115kg) means it won't damage delicate, easily marked lawn surfaces; its five-position cutting-height range allows you to gradually fine-tune the finish until it's what you're looking for. Further attractive features on this high-quality but attractively priced ride-on mower include a five-speed manual transmission (4+1), which makes it possible to drive a speed most suitable for the length of grass and the nature of your garden's terrain; and a large-displacement, 224cc four-stroke air-cooled engine, which, due to its OHV design, delivers its ample power - 6hp - cleanly, quietly and smoothly. It should be noted that Spectrum pedestrian lawnmowers and ride-on mowers are covered by an extended five-year manufacturer's warranty for parts*. * Ts & Cs apply - to maintain a valid warranty, the machine must be serviced annually from year two onwards.
base_row.productFeatures1: One of the most compact ride-on lawnmowers available!
base_row.productFeatures2: Bigger than the largest walk-behinds; more compact than the smallest tractor mowers
base_row.productFeatures3: Perfect if access to different areas of your garden is tight
